name: chatgpt-codex-plugin-autopilot
description: Generic autopilot for building, repairing, validating, packaging, and submission-preflighting ChatGPT/Codex Plugins

interface.longDescription: Audits arbitrary repositories, builds or repairs ChatGPT/Codex Plugin configuration, catches package and final-directory validation failures, packages deterministic installable ZIPs, and separates artifact proof from public submission readiness.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repository and make its ChatGPT/Codex Plugin production-ready.
Validate and package this repository as an installable ChatGPT/Codex Plugin.
Diagnose this Plugin submission failure and repair the root cause.
